name.en: What emerges depends on how the emergents interact

source.locator: The objections on record (Em's amendment); Open questions; claim 15

sense.en: Em's amendment: communities and formulas for cooperation become a paradigm that can grow only by their interaction. So the missing design object is not the camp but the coupling between camps, which v6's cut Cross-Pollinate step alone addressed. Fragments of the alternative need a way to recognize each other.

entries.quote: it's only by their interaction that they will become a paradigm that actually can grow

reading.en: The account has laws on exactly this gap. Two locally successful plans on one reserve fail at the joint step. Being joined through couplings is not enough for agreement: on a path a – c – b, a and b never agree. A pool tells apart only what some member does. So camp-level success does not give joint success, and a map is not yet the coupling that would. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process; periphery for the witness): two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step, and serialization without renewal does not repair it. Applications must establish projection and compatibility.
Being joined through couplings is not enough: on a path a – c – b, each following the least-indexed of itself and its neighbours, a and b never agree. How long agreement takes is not stated.
Theorem: a group's closure is the union of its members'. It does not show which formations pool, how a pool forms or lasts, or that a pool responds to what it separates.

account_adds.en: Failure cases that are exact, on models; none says which inter-group coupling works.

source_adds.en: That interaction among communities is what makes a paradigm grow, and recognition among fragments as the rationale for a festival.

name.en: Emergence is too slow and indeterminate for a narrow window

source.locator: The objections on record (Kabir; Em's timescale)

sense.en: Kabir: a narrow window is a matter of time, and what is proposed is neither fast nor determinate. Em: a mindset shift takes years in a social container, which sits badly with a two-week festival. Ren answers that the window is itself the recruiting condition, and that emergence has surprised before.

entries.quote: this kind of thing that you are describing is actually not very fast and also very indeterminate

reading.en: The account names time and pace among its six conditions: before the point of no return and the share's step; a slow rule reading the fast level over a long enough stretch. Around a loop of couplings the pace bounds what difference can arrive. How long a code takes to agree is expressly not stated. So the objection's form stands, with no rate to answer it. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: among six conditions, Time, before the regime's point of no return and before the share reaches the step from which the late reading favours the shapers; Pace, a slow rule reading the fast level over a long enough stretch.
'Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and its pace bounds what can arrive.' That an actual difference grows at the pace its carried amount bounds is not shown (05).
The laws of a code formed between formations, on runs of hearings. 'How long agreement takes is not stated.'

account_adds.en: That lateness has an exact form in the models, and that nothing here gives a time for an actual collective.

source_adds.en: The empirical rates: years for a mindset, two weeks for a festival, and Ren's reply that urgency recruits.

name.en: Narrative produces consensus, consensus leads to action

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia; The objections on record (narrative not sufficient); claim 108

sense.en: The mechanism Ren draws from Dali, in three steps: through narrative, consensus is produced among a crowd; consensus leads to action; so large-scale decentralized coordination can arise and be productive. Kabir objects that narrative is necessary but not sufficient, and that connecting ideas to materials is the hard part.

entries.quote: 通过叙事在群体之间产生共识，并导向行动

reading.en: The first step has laws: how forms become shared, what breaks symmetry. The account does not call this narrative. The second step is what it keeps apart: seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance, and its one institution model merges recognition, compliance and implementation into a count, so its laws say nothing of them. So the step from consensus to action is withheld, which is Kabir's side of the objection. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): the forms that can become shared are exactly those in use; from a symmetric start a law keeping both symmetries never brings agreement; a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry in a witness.

Not shown: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance. Seeing is not valuing. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.
A minimal model of one kind of institution: 'Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them.'

account_adds.en: The separation of agreement from what follows it, and that agreement needs something to break a symmetry.

source_adds.en: Narrative as the producer of consensus, and consensus as the producer of action, claimed from one event.

name.en: Camps as Schelling points

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia; claims 55, 107; Terms: Schelling point

sense.en: A Waca is a natural focal point at which aligned people converge without being directed. In Dali every café and public space took its own character and so became a Schelling point, which is how the crowd found each other with the centre gone.

entries.quote: 塑造了一个个Schelling points

reading.en: A focal point has the form of what the account requires to leave symmetry: among exactly symmetric parties a preferred form, an order or an actual asymmetry must single one out. A café's character would be such an asymmetry. The law says something must break it; it says nothing of salience, and the source's 'without being directed' is not stated. ALIGNMENT cites Schelling for critical mass, a different use. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: from a start symmetric under the exchange and the renaming, a law keeping both never brings formations it exchanges to agree where the renaming moves every form; in a witness a formation both hear, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry and bring agreement.
Theorem (two roles; periphery module): among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure, whose warrant is open.

account_adds.en: Why a focal asymmetry is needed at all, as an exact condition on two models.

source_adds.en: Salience in a physical place, and convergence of the aligned without direction.

name.en: Entry by resonance, not credential

source.locator: The argument: Wamotopia, and what it claims to demonstrate; claim 64; Open questions (Demographic narrowness)

sense.en: The only entry requirement is 共鸣, resonance: no passport, no credential. In an age of abundance resonance is the real luxury. A group first resonates with the narrative and reaches the principle second.

entries.quote: 进入 Wamotopia 不需要护照，只需要'共鸣'

reading.en: The source offers resonance as openness. If those who resonate are those the pool already reads alike, this has the form of a pool recruiting through itself, which comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would. A reader admitted from outside is what parts them. That resonance recruits so is my reading and empirical; the README's self-selected sample points the same way. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; recruitment through the pool and the same members at the start as hypotheses): it comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; the scheduled pool admitting a reader at step 2 couples the loss apart there. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.
Open: resisting a capture that hides a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read.

account_adds.en: What an entry rule of this kind cannot read, and what would open it.

source_adds.en: Resonance as a value and as a felt admission, with no check beyond the fit list and dialogue.

name.en: A zone where the rules of Moloch are suspended

source.locator: The argument: The unit of instantiation; claim 53

sense.en: A Waca is a Temporary Autonomous Zone (Hakim Bey's term, borrowed) where Moloch's rules are suspended and Wamo's apply: a micro-civilization, started by anyone without permission, on any street. The design around it is mapped nowhere; the claim here is that a local suspension is possible and meaningful.

entries.quote: where the rules of Moloch are suspended and the rules of Wamo apply

reading.en: The account gives where a local suspension holds. A part's own widening widens the whole only within others' margins, and where the rest outruns a shared renewal the condition ends whatever a member outside the rest takes: a zone does not suspend what it still draws on. In form a temporary departure is what widening under a rule needs, some bounded stretch outside its moves, and that is necessary, not sufficient. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; the gate): where the rest jointly take more than a step gives from a level low enough, every formation depending at the need ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes.
Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): a part's activity widening its own region widens the whole exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region.

Theorem (any process; witnesses): where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout. Endless change of a held part does not suffice.

account_adds.en: The dependence a zone keeps on what lies outside it; 05 reads that withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation.

source_adds.en: The zone as a lived experiment and what people learn in it. The README calls the Dali centre's removal unrepeatable by design.

name.en: Winner-takes-all dynamics shrink the horizon

source.locator: Claim 27

sense.en: On the meta level our minds are sucked into an illusion of control, accumulation, optimization and competition; winner-takes-all dynamics shrink our horizon so short that we do not behave as if we know what we are doing, and care for the whole drops out of our rationale.

entries.quote: shrink our horizon so short that we do not even behave

reading.en: The shrinking has a form with no illusion in it: among two drawers or more ranking by position a best response keeps nothing, whatever a longer horizon would give, and a weighting falling faster than renewal ends the base at the first step. Both are orders supplied, not minds shrunk. It does not show actual races are so played. 'Know what we are doing' does not meet them. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: among two drawers or more ranking by position, a best response keeps nothing; where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, every perfect profile draws everything before the horizon. With one drawer every profile is perfect. It does not show that actual races are so played.
Theorem (any R): where later draws are weighted down faster than renewal, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step, breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start.

account_adds.en: That the short horizon can be the optimum of an order, with no error in it; no law calls it wrong.

source_adds.en: Illusion as a state of mind, the omission of wisdom that greed is not good, and care for the whole as a missing rationale.

name.en: People are products of their environment, so the lever is an environment

source.locator: Strategy: obsolescence; claims 29, 79, 83

sense.en: Everything is constructed by its environment and in turn shapes you; the mind is not rigid. So the lever is an environment: a place and coherent narratives that blend with daily life. Changing the collective mentality aligns with everyone's incentives, because we are all products of our environments.

entries.quote: because we're all products of our environments

reading.en: The two-way form is in the reading loop: a formation reads through what it senses and what it does is part of what goes on. The inference to a lever is scoped: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter, and coupling fixes nothing within its bound. 'Readers are minds' stays a reading. Nothing live says environment change aligns incentives. [AI reading]

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.
Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance.

account_adds.en: The limit of the lever, and that selection may ignore what its couplings carry.

source_adds.en: Plasticity of actual minds, 'products of environment' as a general claim, and culture as the lever. The phenomenological route in 03's terms is not taken up.

name.en: Not utopia: stabilize and keep going, and there is a future

source.locator: Strategy: obsolescence; claim 100

sense.en: Ren's 2026 modesty: he does not aim at utopia. As long as we stabilize and keep going we have a future, and as long as we have a future there are chances to make things better. This sits against the manifestos' Great Liberation and dominant attractor.

entries.quote: I am not shooting for utopia, as long as we can stabilize and keeps on going, we have a future.

reading.en: T8 has this form: a wish that life go on motivates avoiding degeneration, ending on every branch, which keeping excludes as well as generation does. But that the wider course is better is C's, and the wish does not give it. Scope: stable under one fixed rule does not keep the possible widening, so 'chances to make things better' needs more than stability. Both premises stay unasserted. [AI reading]

says.en: T8: a wish that life go on motivates avoiding degeneration, ending on every branch, which keeping excludes as well as generation does. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's. The condition fixes scope; neither premise asserted.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once; the alignment of the joint selection is stated as conditions on how its rules are read and revised, and not as a final state.

account_adds.en: The distinction between going on, keeping and widening, and which premise each comparison takes.

source_adds.en: The modest target as a programme's stance, and hope as what a future buys.

name.en: The city as a production machine that atomizes

sense.en: The diagnosis this programme answers, from 2021: the city is a social machine designed to maximize production, which disciplines people into labour, atomizes them and dissolves the 附近, the nearby. The deficit is a structural problem of the city's social-connection mechanism, which is why the answer is spatial, not merely social.
